newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Petron shuts thermal cracker after blast.
newsitem.headline: Petron shuts thermal cracker after blast.

text.p: A 15,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) thermal cracker unit at Petron's Bataan refinery North of Manila was shut following an explosion on Friday at a catalyst cooler, Petron officials said on Monday.
The unit, which produces diesel, gasoline and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) was running at around 10,000-12,000-bpd at the time of the incident, they said.
"The refinery would want to put the unit back up within a week," one official said. "We are making careful assessment and don't want to prolong it."

But an official at Petron's planning unit told Reuters that they do not have immediate plans to import any oil products because the refinery has buffer stocks of diesel and gasoline to last for 40 days.
"Its always our policy to stock up if there is a swing in demand, now we need the stocks because of a swing in production capabiliity," he said.
The refinery will also depend on Saudi Aramco, which has a 40-percent stake in Petron, to supply it with LPG.
